ev.q: What finally made open plans almost universal, however, was not a theory of work but the price of property

1.why: B段前面讲历史，主旨要看最后一句：真正推动开放式办公普及的是房产价格。iv An economic motive behind a design history ↔ not a theory of work but the price of property。i 只对应 Larkin 大楼一个细节（supervision），不是整段主旨。

ev.q: Far from increasing, face-to-face interaction fell by roughly 70 per cent

2.why: C段。viii Closeness that drove people apart ↔ 搬进开放空间后 face-to-face interaction fell … people … withdrawing。vii 是细节陷阱：headphones 只是人们退缩的表现之一，不是解决办法，更不是主旨。

ev.q: A small reduction in efficiency, she points out, repeated across every working hour of every employee, may cost an organisation more than the rent it saved

3.why: D段。ii Why small losses should not be overlooked ↔ cautions against dismissing such figures … A small reduction in efficiency … may cost an organisation more…。

ev.q: depended far more on whether they could find somewhere quiet when they needed it than on whether their main desk was enclosed

4.why: E段先让步再落到 Okonkwo 的结论。x Somewhere to retreat counts for more than walls ↔ whether they could find somewhere quiet … than on whether their main desk was enclosed。xi 只是段首让步中的一个例子（new employees learn by observing），不是段落主旨。

ev.q: In principle, this answers the critics. In practice, the results have been mixed.

5.why: F段。vi A promising compromise that has often fallen short ↔ In principle, this answers the critics. In practice, the results have been mixed。

ev.q: An honest assessment would admit the trade-off openly

6.why: G段。ix Calling for candour about competing priorities ↔ An honest assessment would admit the trade-off openly（cost 与 concentration 的取舍）。v 是陷阱：段首明确说 None of this means that private offices for everyone are the answer。

ev.q: face-to-face interaction fell by roughly 70 per cent, while the use of email and instant messaging rose

7.why: C段。B replaced many in-person exchanges with written ones ↔ face-to-face interaction fell … email and instant messaging rose。A 与 fell 相反；C 与 rose 相反；D 文中没提要求隔断，退缩的方式是戴耳机、避免眼神接触。

ev.q: cautions against dismissing such figures, however. A small reduction in efficiency, she points out, repeated across every working hour of every employee

8.why: D段。apparently minor effects ↔ modest effects, of the order of a few per cent；add up to a considerable cost ↔ repeated across every working hour … may cost an organisation more than the rent。D 方向相反：她说损失可能超过节省的租金；A 她并没说实验夸大了影响。

ev.q: Companies adopting the model have often provided too few quiet spaces, partly because the original motive, saving space, has not gone away

9.why: F段。the pressure to economise ↔ the original motive, saving space, has not gone away；limited the number of quiet areas ↔ provided too few quiet spaces。A 是陷阱：文中说员工很少换位置（rarely move），不是反对没有固定座位。

ev.q: the choice of layout has too often been justified by claims about collaboration while being driven by cost

10.why: 全文主旨见A段末和G段：开放式办公真正的动因是成本，应承认这种取舍并衡量代价。A 被G段首句否定；B 只是B段的内容；C 只对应E段的让步。

ev.q: although the purpose there was as much supervision as cooperation

11.why: B段。not only cooperation but also ↔ as much supervision as cooperation；meant to aid ↔ the purpose there was。cooperation 题干已经给出，所以空格只能填另一个目的 supervision。

ev.q: desks were grouped irregularly according to the flow of work

12.why: B段。arranged to follow ↔ grouped … according to；tasks ↔ work。

ev.q: with plants and screens rather than walls dividing one group from another

13.why: B段。not walls ↔ rather than walls；groups separated by ↔ dividing one group from another。screens 已在题干中。

ev.q: was not a theory of work but the price of property

14.why: B段。main reason open plans spread ↔ What finally made open plans almost universal；cost ↔ price。不要填 rent（D段），那是后文的论证，且原文这里用的是 property。
